senses.gloss:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Shaking, making tremble.
E.
उद before एज to tremble, श aff.

m. (-शः)
1 Illustration, explanation, exemplification.
2 Search, enquiry.
3 Stipulation, bargain.
4 An object, a motive.
mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Relative to.
E.
उद् and देश showing.

mf. (-कः-का-कं)
What explains or shows, illustrative, explanatory.
m. (-कः)
1 An illustration, an example.
2 An illustrator.
3 A guide.
E.
उद् before दिश to show, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
To be illustrated or explained.
E.
उद्, दिश to show, ण्यत् aff.

f. (-का)
The white ant, termes; also उत्यादिका.
